integrity: All-dimensional proof derives from a spherical-cap integral, Brunn–Minkowski concavity, endpoint slopes, and uniform integration-by-parts asymptotics. Finite numerical checks corroborate but do not replace proof.
limitations: Determines only relative ordering of ellipsoid and simplex convolution-level volume ratios; not the global minimizer. The general crossover is implicit, and historical priority remains provisional. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
title: Unique ball–simplex crossover for covariogram level bodies and its dimension law
